youtube.description: Is saal March mein naye SIP se zyada SIP band ho gaye. 500 rupaye ki SIP, rupee cost averaging, achha aur flat daur, expense ratio aur tax, sab ek ghar ki kahani mein samjhiye. script.end_question: Market gire toh aap: SIP chalne do ya rok do?
script.hook: Is saal March mein naye SIP se zyada SIP band ho gaye.

scenes.label: March ka darr: 101 percent

visual.prompt: A crowded city street at dusk, many people looking anxiously at their phones showing red falling charts, a large stock market screen glowing red in the background, tense mood

scenes.vo: Is saal March mein ek ajeeb cheez hui. Jitne naye SIP khule, usse zyada band ho gaye. Market hila, aur logon ne apni monthly investment rok di. SIP stoppage ratio 101 percent ke paar chala gaya. Matlab har naye account ke badle, usse zyada purane account band hue.

visual.prompt: A long running track drawn as a road, several runners sitting down exhausted in the middle of the track while a few keep running toward a distant sunrise, symbolic illustration

scenes.vo: Stoppage ratio yaani band hue SIP accounts ko naye registered accounts se compare karna. Jab yeh ratio itna upar jaata hai, toh ek hi matlab hai. Log darr gaye hain. Jo log lambi race daudne aaye the, woh beech raste mein baith gaye.

visual.prompt: Night, a modest Indian living room after dinner, BHAI in a hoodie frowning at his phone showing a red chart, MUMMY in a saree holding a cup of chai looking worried beside him

scenes.vo: Ab ek ghar ki kahani suniye. Raat ka khaana ho chuka tha. Rohan ke phone pe fund app ka notification aaya. Portfolio laal tha, market neeche. Mummy ne poocha, beta, sab theek hai na? Rohan ne kaha, pata nahi, shayad SIP rok doon.

visual.prompt: A row of apartment windows at night, in each window a family huddled around a glowing phone screen, same worried posture repeated, wide shot

scenes.vo: Yeh sawaal sirf Rohan ka nahi hai. Bahut saare gharon mein usi raat yahi baat hui. Isliye aaj ke sawaal seedhe hain. 500 rupaye mahine ki SIP se sach mein kya banta hai? Market gire toh SIP band karna sahi hai? Aur expense ratio chupchap kitna kha jaata hai?

visual.prompt: SG, early forties with a beard and striped shirt, sitting calmly at a dining table with a notebook and a calculator, warm lamp light, friendly expression as if starting a story

scenes.vo: Main koi tip nahi dunga, koi promise nahi karunga. Bas seedhi baat, ek ghar ki kahani ke saath. Calculator jo dikhata hai, aur zindagi jo dikhati hai, dono ko saath rakh ke dekhenge. Chaliye, shuru se shuru karte hain, Rohan ki pehli salary se.

scenes.label: 500 ki SIP kaise chalti hai

visual.prompt: Daytime office cafeteria, BHAI laughing with a colleague over tea, his phone showing a salary credit message, a small pile of bills and a rent receipt on the table

scenes.vo: Rohan ki pehli naukri lagi. Salary aayi, aur rent, EMI, ghar ka kharcha nikal ke thoda hi bacha. Office ke ek dost ne kaha, SIP shuru kar. Rohan hansa, itne kam paise se kya hoga? Dost bola, pehle shuru toh kar, baaki baad mein dekhenge.

visual.prompt: Illustrated concept: many small streams of coins from different houses flowing into one big pot, a calm fund manager in an office tending the pot and placing coins into baskets, soft daylight

scenes.vo: SIP yaani Systematic Investment Plan. Har mahine ek fixed din, ek fixed amount, bank se apne aap mutual fund mein jaata hai. Mutual fund yaani bahut logon ka paisa ek jagah, jise ek fund manager shares ya bonds mein lagata hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI on a sofa in the evening tapping a confirm button on his phone with a shy smile, a single small coin floating from the phone into a glass jar on the table

scenes.vo: Rohan ne 500 rupaye mahine ki SIP shuru ki. Usko laga yeh chhoti si cheez hai, bhool jaunga. Aur sach mein, yahi iski taakat thi. Paisa account se nikal gaya, kharch hone se pehle. Bachat pehle, kharcha baad mein. Yeh aadat hi asli shuruaat thi.

visual.prompt: A steel thali with many small katoris, one katori being added each month by a hand, a market board in the background showing a price that changes, warm kitchen light

scenes.vo: Ab har mahine us 500 se units milte hain. Unit yaani fund ka ek chhota hissa, jaise thali ki ek katori. Har din fund ki ek keemat hoti hai, jise NAV kehte hain. NAV yaani ek unit ka aaj ka daam, jo roz badalta hai.

visual.prompt: Split illustration: on one side a tall price tower with a hand receiving few coins worth of units, on the other side a low price with the same hand receiving a big handful, balanced scale in the middle

scenes.vo: Yahan ek mazedaar cheez hoti hai. Jab market upar hai, NAV mehnga hai, toh usi paise mein kam units milte hain. Jab market neeche hai, NAV sasta hai, toh zyada units milte hain. Isi ko rupee cost averaging kehte hain, keemat ka apne aap average ho jaana.

visual.prompt: Morning vegetable market, MUMMY with a cloth bag buying tomatoes from a vendor, one panel half showing a nearly empty bag, the other a full bag, cheerful bustle

scenes.vo: Socho sabzi wala. Tamatar mehnga ho, toh aap utne hi paise mein kam tamatar laate ho. Sasta ho, toh thaila bhar jaata hai. Lambe time mein aapki average keemat beech mein aa jaati hai. Na sabse sasti, na sabse mehngi, bas beech ki.

visual.prompt: A rainy evening, an umbrella-holding figure calmly walking forward on a downhill road while collecting coins from puddles, others running away in the background

scenes.vo: Isliye girta market SIP wale ke liye sirf bura nahi hota. Usi time sabse zyada units judte hain. Lekin dhyaan rahe, rupee cost averaging nuksaan rokne ki guarantee nahi hai. Yeh sirf darr ke time pe bhi sahi kaam karte rehne ka ek tareeka hai.

visual.prompt: PAPA in a kurta sitting in an armchair holding a neat bundle of FD receipts, smiling gently at BHAI who holds his phone, evening light through a window

scenes.vo: Papa ne yeh sab suna aur muskuraye. Bole, beta, meri FD mein kam se kam pata toh hai kitna milega. Aur Papa galat bhi nahi hain. FD ki apni jagah hai. Sawaal bas yeh hai, kis kaam ke liye kaunsa paisa rakhna hai.

scenes.label: Achha daur, sookha daur

visual.prompt: BHAI late at night in front of a laptop, a glowing upward line on the screen reflecting in his excited eyes, dreamy thought bubbles of a car and a house above his head

scenes.vo: Ab aata hai woh sawaal jo har koi poochta hai. 500 ki SIP se aakhir banega kitna? Internet pe SIP calculator khol lo. Ek return daalo, saal daalo, aur ek bada sa number chamak jaata hai. Dil khush ho jaata hai, sapne shuru ho jaate hain.

visual.prompt: A straight smooth road drawn on paper next to a real mountain road full of climbs, dips and long flat stretches, contrasting illustration, clear daylight

scenes.vo: Lekin calculator ek seedhi line maanta hai. Har saal same return, bina rukawat. Market aise nahi chalta. Kabhi ek decade mein bahut achha return aata hai. Kabhi poora decade lagbhag flat nikal jaata hai. Flat yaani lambe time tak market wahin ka wahin.

visual.prompt: BEHEN in office wear and BHAI in a hoodie standing side by side, each watering an identical small plant, one plant under bright sun, the other under grey clouds

scenes.vo: Socho Rohan aur uski behen. Behen ne SIP pehle shuru ki, ek aise daur mein jab market saalon tak tez bhaaga. Rohan ne baad mein ki, jab market lambe time tak sust raha. Dono ne same amount daala, same discipline rakha.

visual.prompt: BEHEN holding a tall leafy plant smiling, BHAI holding a plant that barely grew, looking at it confused and disappointed, soft afternoon light

scenes.vo: Result bilkul alag aaya. Behen ka portfolio badha hua dikha. Rohan ka portfolio kayi saal tak lagbhag wahin pada raha. Rohan ko laga, maine kuch galat kiya. Lekin usne kuch galat nahi kiya tha. Bas uska daur alag tha.

visual.prompt: SG sitting at the dining table drawing a wide shaded band instead of a single line on a notebook, thoughtful expression, warm lamp light

scenes.vo: Yeh hai sabse imaandaar baat. SIP ka result sirf aapke discipline pe nahi, aapke daur pe bhi depend karta hai. Aur woh daur aap choose nahi kar sakte. Isliye calculator ka koi ek number pakad ke baithna galti hai. Range socho, promise nahi.

visual.prompt: WIFE at a kitchen table with a notebook budget, a hospital bill, a wedding card and a school fee slip spread out, she rubs her forehead, evening light

scenes.vo: Ek aur sach. Calculator maanta hai aap har mahine bina chooke paisa daaloge. Asli zindagi mein naukri badalti hai, shaadi hoti hai, hospital ka bill aata hai. Kabhi SIP rukti hai, kabhi ghat jaati hai. Ghar ka budget calculator ki tarah nahi chalta.

visual.prompt: A farmer-like figure resembling BHAI sowing seeds in a dry field under a pale sky, dark rain clouds gathering far on the horizon, quiet hopeful mood

scenes.vo: Toh achha kya hai? Flat daur mein bhi SIP chalti rahi, toh units sasti keemat pe judte rahe. Jab market baad mein utha, toh wahi units kaam aaye. Sookhe daur ki mehnat, baarish ke daur mein dikhti hai. Par baarish kab aayegi, koi nahi bata sakta.

visual.prompt: PAPA holding a passbook and BHAI holding his phone sitting together on a bench, a toolbox between them with a hammer and a screwdriver, friendly mood, afternoon

scenes.vo: Isse compare karo PPF se, jahan abhi 7.1 percent saal ka byaaj milta hai, government ka tay kiya hua rate. PPF mein number pata hota hai. Equity SIP mein number pata nahi hota, range hoti hai. Dono alag kaam ke auzaar hain, dushman nahi.

scenes.label: Expense ratio kya khata hai

visual.prompt: BEHEN in office wear leaning over BHAI's shoulder pointing at a statement on his phone with a sceptical raised eyebrow, BHAI looks blank, evening living room

scenes.vo: Ab aate hain us cheez pe jo dikhti nahi, par roz kha jaati hai. Behen ne Rohan ka statement dekha aur poocha, yeh fund chalane ka kharcha kaun deta hai? Rohan chup ho gaya. Jawab hai, aap. Har din, chupchap, bina bill ke.

visual.prompt: A big pot of coins with a tiny tap at the bottom slowly dripping coins into a bucket labelled by an office building drawing, a fund office in the background, no text

scenes.vo: Expense ratio yaani fund chalane ki saalana fees, aapke paise ke percent mein. Fund manager ki salary, office, research, sab isi se chalta hai. Yeh bill alag se nahi aata. Yeh seedha fund ki NAV se kat jaata hai, roz thoda thoda.

visual.prompt: Close view of MUMMY stirring sugar into a steel cup of chai, the sugar dissolving and disappearing, steam rising, cosy kitchen morning light

scenes.vo: Isliye zyada log isko notice hi nahi karte. Bank se paisa gaya, units aaye, NAV dikhi. Fees kahin alag line mein nahi dikhti. Jaise chai mein cheeni ghuli ho, dikhti nahi, par meethapan har ghoont mein hota hai.

visual.prompt: A growing snowball rolling downhill, small chips of it being shaved off by a little blade as it rolls, illustrating fees cutting compounding, bright winter day

scenes.vo: Ab socho, yeh fees sirf aapke daale hue paise pe nahi lagti. Yeh poore jama paise pe lagti hai, jisme aapka return bhi shamil hai. Aur jo fees kat gayi, woh aage compound nahi hoti. Compound yaani byaaj pe byaaj, return pe return.

visual.prompt: A road where a tiny crack at the start widens into a large pit further ahead, a family car approaching it at sunset, symbolic

scenes.vo: Ek saal mein fark chhota lagta hai. Lekin decades mein yeh chhota fark ek bada gaddha ban jaata hai. Fees ka bhi compounding hota hai, bas ulta. Aapke paise ka ek hissa har saal fund ke paas chala jaata hai, aur kabhi wapas nahi aata.

visual.prompt: Two identical gift boxes on a shop counter, one with an extra middleman's hand reaching for a coin beside it, SHOPKEEPER watching neutrally, daylight

scenes.vo: Mutual funds mein aksar regular aur direct, aise plan hote hain. Regular plan mein distributor ka commission bhi fees mein judta hai. Direct plan mein woh commission nahi hota, isliye expense ratio aam taur pe kam hota hai. Fund wahi, kharcha alag.

visual.prompt: BEHEN and BHAI sitting together at a laptop, BEHEN pointing at a document page, BHAI taking notes with a focused expression, evening lamp light

scenes.vo: Iska matlab yeh nahi ki sabse sasta fund hi sabse achha hai. Matlab sirf itna hai, fees ko dekhna seekho. Har fund ki factsheet mein expense ratio likha hota hai. Thoda sa time lagta hai, par decades ka fark pad sakta hai.

visual.prompt: A harvest basket of fruit with a small portion being set aside on a separate plate at a table, PAPA watching and nodding, warm afternoon light

scenes.vo: Aur paisa nikaalte waqt tax bhi hissa leta hai. Long term capital gain yaani equity fund mein saal bhar se zyada rakhne ke baad ka munafa. Uspe 12.5 percent tax lagta hai. Lekin saal mein 1.25 lakh tak ke aise gain pe tax nahi lagta.

scenes.label: Crash mein SIP band karna

visual.prompt: Night, close shot of BHAI's thumb hovering over a phone screen, MUMMY beside him placing a cup of chai with an anxious face, dim room light

scenes.vo: Ab wapas us raat pe chalte hain. Market gira hua tha. Mummy ne chai rakhi aur boli, beta, ruk ja, sab doob jayega. Rohan ka angootha app ke pause button pe tha. Usko laga, yahi samajhdaari hai, yahi bachao hai.

visual.prompt: A queue of people at a bank counter at closing time, BANK UNCLE behind the counter handing back forms, faces tense and hurried

scenes.vo: Uski soch samajh mein aati hai. Jab sab laal dikh raha ho, toh lagta hai aur paisa daalna aag mein ghee daalna hai. Rok do, market sambhle toh wapas aa jaana. Sunne mein bilkul logical lagta hai. Aur is saal March mein, bahut logon ne yahi kiya.

visual.prompt: A big sale market with discounted goods piled high and shoppers running out the exit in fear, the shopkeeper looking puzzled, evening light

scenes.vo: Wahi data yaad karo. Stoppage ratio 101 percent ke paar gaya. Matlab naye SIP se zyada SIP band hue. Log ussi waqt bhaage, jab cheezein sabse sasti mil rahi thi. Yeh market ka nahi, hamare darr ka number hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI walking away from a vegetable stall just as the vendor puts up cheaper prices, a full basket left behind, ironic mood, afternoon

scenes.vo: Ab rupee cost averaging wapas yaad karo. Girte market mein usi 500 se sabse zyada units milte hain. SIP band karte hi, aap wahi mahine chhod dete ho jo aapka average neeche laate. Mehnga khareedte rahe, aur sasta aate hi dukaan chhod di.

visual.prompt: A man waiting at a railway platform watching a train already pulling away, checking his watch, sunrise behind the departing train

scenes.vo: Aur wapas aane ka time? Wahi sabse mushkil hai. Jab market sambhalta hai, tab tak keemat upar ja chuki hoti hai. Log sochte hain thoda aur girega toh daalenge. Aur yahi intezaar saalon kha jaata hai. Giraav nahi, hamara rukna nuksaan karta hai.

visual.prompt: SG at the dining table looking directly ahead with a calm serious expression, a small chalkboard behind him with a drawn wave line, evening

scenes.vo: Toh sabse badi galti kya hai? Galti market girna nahi hai, woh toh hota rahega. Galti hai darr mein faisla lena. Ek aur galti hai, SIP shuru karte waqt yeh na sochna ki paisa kis kaam ke liye hai, aur kab chahiye.

visual.prompt: WIFE placing money into a separate steel box marked with a drawn red cross symbol, beside a small glass jar of coins, organised kitchen shelf, morning

scenes.vo: Toh kya karein? Pehle emergency ke liye alag paisa rakho, taaki hospital ya naukri ke jhatke mein SIP na todni pade. SIP utni hi rakho jitni har mahine aaram se chal sake. Chhoti par lagatar SIP, badi par toot-ti hui SIP se behtar hai.

visual.prompt: The whole family at the dining table with a calendar and a notebook, PAPA with FD receipts, BHAI with phone, BEHEN with a pen, discussing calmly, warm evening light

scenes.vo: Paisa kab chahiye, yeh pehle socho. Jo paisa jaldi chahiye, woh equity mein nahi, FD ya kisi safe jagah pe. Jo lambe time ke liye hai, wahan SIP soch sakte ho. Saal mein ek baar fund ka expense ratio aur apna goal check karo. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI putting his phone face down on the table and picking up a cup of chai with a relieved small smile, MUMMY and PAPA smiling beside him, late night

scenes.vo: Us raat Rohan ne pause nahi dabaya. Papa ne apni FD rakhi, Rohan ne SIP chalne di, aur Behen ne fees check ki. Har kisi ka paisa apne kaam pe laga. Kahani ka hero koi fund nahi tha. Hero tha, darr mein na bhaagna.

visual.prompt: SG leaning forward at the dining table with an inviting smile, gesturing openly toward the viewer, warm lamp light

scenes.vo: Ab aapse ek sawaal. Market gire toh aap kya karte ho? SIP chalne dete ho, ya rok dete ho? Comment mein bas ek shabd likho, chalne ya rok. Sach likhna, yahan koi judge nahi karega, sab seekh rahe hain.

visual.prompt: PAPA looking at an FD receipt while a shopping bag beside him shrinks with fewer groceries, curious puzzled expression, dusk light, teaser mood

scenes.vo: Agli baar baat karenge us cheez ki jo FD wale sabse kam dekhte hain, mehngai. Aapka byaaj badh raha hai, ya mehngai usse tez bhaag rahi hai? Woh kahani agle video mein. Tab tak seedhi baat yaad rakho, pehle samjho, phir paisa lagao.
